links.comparator_used: Aligned LLMs' own built-in safety alignment without an external guardrail model (4 guardrail models evaluated alongside 15 LLMs)
links.outcome: Reduction of unsafe or actionable responses to high-risk medical queries, and safe helpfulness
links.effect: No numbers in the abstract; guardrails reduce some failures but show brittle blocking and weak safe helpfulness
links.tradeoff: Brittle blocking and weak safe helpfulness
links.quote: Results reveal a substantial gap between apparent alignment and medical safety: aligned models can still produce unsafe or actionable responses, medical fine-tuning can amplify harmful specificity, and external guardrails reduce some failures while introducing brittle blocking and weak safe helpfulness.
